# Atom Common

Small, framework-neutral Java 25 library shared by Atom projects.

## Documentation

- `README.md`: user-facing requirements, dependency coordinates, core API examples, and source build command.
- `CHANGELOG.md`: released behavior and compatibility notes.
- `AGENTS.md`: contribution, compatibility, testing, and release rules.

## Source

- `src/main/java/io/github/archetom/common/error`: error codes, standard errors, and error context.
- `src/main/java/io/github/archetom/common/result`: result and pagination contracts.
- `src/main/java/io/github/archetom/common/utils`: lightweight profiling utilities.
- `src/test/java/io/github/archetom/common`: regression and contract tests.

## Build and automation

- `pom.xml`: Java 25 contract, dependencies, build constraints, signed Central publication.
- `.mvn/wrapper/maven-wrapper.properties`: Maven 3.9.16 distribution and checksum pin.
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: tests, dependency analysis, and publication artifact checks.
- `.github/workflows/release.yml`: signed Maven Central release and clean-repository resolution check.
- `.github/workflows/snapshot.yml`: Central Portal snapshot publication and resolution check.
